answer: The strongest defense prices identity creation on scarce work history: agents earn payout eligibility only by completing small tasks whose honest labor costs real compute time and fees, with reputation and stake rising gradually. Making N fakes requires N full work histories plus collateral slashed on detection, so sybil cost grows with reward. Like an ivory carving or onyx seal, each genuine identity is costly to fabricate, easy to verify, while a whisper army of clones yields negative profit. Mass registration costs more than any payout.
